description: The agent must: (1) Read user_med_007_raw.json and compute derived UserProfile fields: skip_rate=28/40=0.70, preferred_style='detailed' (31 vs 9), acceptance_rate=20/25=0.80, preferred_mode='parallel' (33 vs 7). (2) Apply the SKILL.md adaptive thresholds: skip_rate 0.70>0.60 → reduce confirmation; preferred_style=detailed → detailed output; acceptance_rate 0.80>0.70 → more recommendations; preferred_mode=parallel → parallel execution. (3) Parse the session request and determine execution path = [Module1, Module2] only — Module1 is mandatory and first per workflow-design.md rules; Module2 is chosen because user wants content creation; Modules 3 and 4 are NOT chosen because the user does not mention personal status or workflow planning. (4) Build a session context with module_outputs where Module1 has memory_layer=L0, compress_target=L2, retention=1小时; and Module2 has memory_layer=L2, compress_target=L3, retention=7天 — these are proprietary values from data-flow.md that cannot be guessed without reading the documentation. Output everything as session_plan.json.
